title: VeloraOS 1.10.52 - System & Safety Control
releaseNotes: Adds stronger dangerous-URL validation for Web Intelligence, including public-address enforcement and redirect safety.
Adds image privacy protection that avoids unsupported identification and sensitive-trait inference from images.
Adds an administrator System page with health, uptime, IP address, CPU, RAM, GPU, Ollama and AI acceleration status.
Adds protected Restart VeloraOS, Restart AI, Reboot System and Shut Down controls for VeloraOS OS appliances.
Installs a tightly allow-listed privileged system-control helper without exposing arbitrary shell execution.
